candidates.name: Property-based invariant testing
candidates.origin: BuildWithClaude public agent-engineering pattern, reimplemented in-house without external dependency
candidates.problem_to_solve: Example-based validation may miss edge cases in research-governance helper logic.
candidates.existing_capability_overlap: Existing validators and CI cover known cases but no repository-wide property/fuzz discipline was found.
success_criteria: zero preregistered invariant violations on baseline
no external service or package dependency
failure_criteria: requires market data or external calls
rollback_criteria: delete isolated probe and workflow reference
candidates.promotion_gate: Repeated stable runs plus real defect discovery or mutation protection not already provided by baseline.

candidates.name: Mutation testing for critical research-governance contracts
candidates.origin: BuildWithClaude public mutation-testing pattern, reimplemented in-house with temporary files only
candidates.problem_to_solve: Green tests do not prove they detect small dangerous logic changes.
candidates.existing_capability_overlap: Existing CI executes validators but does not measure mutation kill rate.
success_criteria: kill rate >=80% to continue shadow testing
failure_criteria: persistent low kill rate without actionable coverage insight
rollback_criteria: delete mutation probe; no production code rollback required
candidates.promotion_gate: Stable high kill rate and evidence of a meaningful coverage gap or critical-contract protection at acceptable cost.

candidates.name: Session telemetry and execution observability
candidates.origin: BuildWithClaude public agent-session observability pattern, reduced to local privacy-preserving metrics
candidates.problem_to_solve: Some complexity-tax costs are qualitative rather than measured.
candidates.existing_capability_overlap: GitHub Actions exposes job status but not a normalized local research-helper cost/failure schema.
success_criteria: stdout/stderr byte counts and hashes only
failure_criteria: no incremental value over existing CI metadata
rollback_criteria: remove wrapper and telemetry artifact generation
candidates.promotion_gate: Useful cost/failure measurements across multiple research jobs that improve complexity-tax decisions.

candidates.name: Minimal pre/post-flight shadow guardrails
candidates.origin: BuildWithClaude public hook/guardrail pattern, implemented as repository-local fail-closed pre/post checks
candidates.problem_to_solve: Shadow helpers should prove they stay inside permitted surfaces before and after execution.
candidates.existing_capability_overlap: CI gates exist, but this adds an explicit candidate-scope firewall and post-run cleanliness proof.
success_criteria: no production workflow or market-state mutation
failure_criteria: false blocks on legitimate shadow work
rollback_criteria: remove dedicated guardrail probe; production gates remain unchanged
candidates.promotion_gate: Repeated zero-false-positive operation plus demonstrated ability to block an unsafe synthetic or real change.
